name: platform-sdlc-harness
description: AI-driven SDLC pipeline on GitHub — Issues + sub-issues + Projects (v2) on a service/web/mobile monorepo. Stack-agnostic via pluggable packs (packs/registry.json — SERVICE: .NET 8 + Go; WEB: React 19 + Turbo; MOBILE: Expo; new languages/frameworks plug in without editing agents/roles). Four-workflow pipeline: discovery-workflow (idea → Epic/Feature/Story/Task tree with hierarchical numbering E1/F1.1/S1.1.1 + Markdown issue bodies + native sub-issue Parent links + native Blocked-by issue dependencies + Project (v2) board membership) → backlog-workflow (refine a Story with issue/body edits, preserves numbering, manages dependencies) → dev-workflow (10-phase build with 3 gates + 3 holistic reviews + Phase 8 architecture/rules reconciliation, two-tier branching, gh PRs) → pr-review (post-PR holistic comments via gh). 4 specialized agents (planner with 5 modes, developer, reviewer with 5 modes incl. gh PR commenting, tester). 8 hooks (5 data-policy incl. attribution-guard + 3 stack quality-check; covered by a hook behavior test suite + GitHub Actions CI). 32 skills total (adds github-rendering canonical structures + sub-issue/dependency protocol, per-stack conventions skills — dotnet-conventions, go-conventions, react-turbo-conventions, expo-mobile-conventions — plus capability/quality/security skills the dev/test/review roles drive, auto-installed by /init-workspace: agent-device + maestro-e2e + react-doctor + expo-doctor mobile/web verification, security-scan (Semgrep/Gitleaks/OSV-Scanner/govulncheck), dead-code-analysis (Knip/madge), dotnet-code-quality (Roslynator), go-code-quality (golangci-lint/staticcheck), bundle-budget (size-limit), migration-safety, api-contract-check (oasdiff), observability (Serilog/OTel/Sentry); all advisory). Uses the gh CLI (no MCP server). Works with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.
